newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain tradeless in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain tradeless in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market remained tradeless this afternoon as a high dollar and a weaker Chicago opening kept buyers firmly on the sidelines, market sources said.

"The strong dollar and calls for a weaker Chicago soycomplex futures opening kept a firm lid on activity. Also a lot of operators were absent visiting a grain bourse in Hamburg which kept the market quiet," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
